findings: Primary study: twelve workloads from ONE benchmark family, one hardware platform, one random seed, no independent replication — stated in its own limitations section.
Replication: three hardware platforms, ten random seeds, full control configuration. The methodologically stronger of the two.
Preliminary note: three author-selected workloads, no control, no statistical test. Unusable for direction; not cited.
warnings: Neither result has been independently replicated more than once; both remain single studies of their respective designs.
